name: Vectorized Voxelization
definition: A vectorized algorithm that bins 3D points into a voxel grid, averaging colors per cell, and returns voxel centers, averaged colors, and the grid origin.
summary: Vectorized Voxelization is a deterministic CPU algorithm that converts sparse 3D point clouds into dense voxel grids by binning points and averaging attributes, differing from GPU methods by using CPU-side sorting and cumulative sums.
